examples.title: Finding LCM of 4 and 6
examples.problem: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 4 and 6.
examples.solution: Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24... Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18, 24... Common: 12, 24. LCM = 12.
examples.explanation: 12 is the smallest number that appears in both lists.

examples.title: Finding HCF of 12 and 18
examples.problem: Find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of 12 and 18.
examples.explanation: 6 is the largest number that divides both 12 and 18.
